description: The line plot titled “Performance w.r.t. Temperature” illustrates the accuracy (Pass@8) of three methods—On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT—as a function of temperature, ranging from 0.1 to 1.0 on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (Pass@8),” spans from 62.5 to 80.0, with major gridlines at 2.5-unit intervals. The orange line with triangle markers, representing On-policy RL, starts at approximately 64.0 at temperature 0.1, rises to a peak of ~75.0 at 0.8, then dips to ~73.5 at 0.9 before recovering slightly to ~74.0 at 1.0. The red line with star markers, corresponding to LUFFY, begins at ~76.0 at 0.1, peaks at ~80.0 at 0.8, dips to ~78.0 at 0.9, and ends at ~80.5 at 1.0, showing overall high and stable performance. The teal line with downward-pointing triangle markers, for SFT, starts at ~76.0 at 0.1, declines to ~71.0 at 0.5, rebounds to ~76.0 at 0.6, dips again to ~72.0 at 0.7, and ends at ~74.5 at 1.0, exhibiting more volatility. A gray square legend marker is present but not associated with any plotted line.
